tool_args.rationale: Six observations show coupled, nontrivial dependence on u_now and s_grad, while u_past, x_now, mem_conv, and H remain fixed. That is not enough to identify the quantitative two-layer law or confirm its forecast error; a fine trajectory batch is the most useful remaining measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed response does not establish a high-u decline, and this law omits the substantial s_grad dependence.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the cited supercritical avalanche siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are below its stated critical range, so the avalanche term is not identified.
The response is not consistently monotonic in s_grad, conflicting with a simple positive power dependence.
It is explicitly irrelevant and comparatively costly.
